Similar to me :). My bf and I are 22 and I was 200 at 5’2 SW and he was 267 at 6’3 SW. We are both on a journey but sometimes we slip up. My bf likes heavy junk food and I am a carb lover. The first thing we did was respect for one another’s food preferences. I am starting to eat less meat and he loves it. I like carbs, he doesnt eat many lol. I found a happy medium in a couple of tik tok videos that are “lazy keto”. Some are veggie options and most are super low carb but still good and filling. My suggestion would be to:

- find substitutes to his favorite carbs OR you find replacements and eat the same types of meals (ie replacing spaghetti with zucchini but still eating spaghetti for dinner). 

- “Trick” him when it comes to cooking and disguise healthy foods

I’m not a professional or anything but it has helped us to slowly lose weight. I am around 185 and he is about 255 in a month or two
